summary: This profile covers the Atlantic blue marlin, Makaira nigricans, a large ocean predator with a spear-like bill. Taxonomic treatments differ: WoRMS separates Indo-Pacific blue marlin as Makaira mazara, while NOAA uses Makaira nigricans across oceans. A Malaysian blue-marlin sighting should therefore not be assigned to this Atlantic profile without checking the identification.
nativeRange: Atlantic tropical and subtropical waters under the taxonomic treatment separating Makaira mazara.

features: Cobalt-blue upper body and silvery-white underside

habitat.description: Warm surface water and the upper ocean water column.
